program.name: Bell Chest
program.subject: Chest
program.blurb: Chest with one kettlebell: one-arm floor presses and push-ups, then a day of legs and rows.
program.about: Chest work for a home with one kettlebell. Two days in three are built on the one-arm floor press, which also makes your core resist the twist, with push-ups and holds around it. One of those days adds floor dips and close-grip push-ups for the triceps. The third day is goblet squats, deadlifts and rows. Abs finish every session; Level II adds reps and Level III slows the reps down.
